description: Seeded secrets for the @mandatory no-leak test (sprint 0.5). Fake values in realistic shapes; the API-key shapes deliberately use non-provider prefixes so no secret scanner mistakes them for real credentials. Each seed's value and every canary fragment must never appear in IndexedDB, chrome.storage, console output, exports, share output, or any network payload. Matching is case-insensitive and whitespace-insensitive.
